author: (Müller & Troschel, 1842)

note.en: A tiny, widespread brittle star of about 2 cm arm span that lives in sponges and under stones, and splits itself to multiply; known here from museum records.
note.es: Una ofiura diminuta y muy extendida, de unos 2 cm de envergadura, que vive en esponjas y bajo piedras y se divide para multiplicarse; conocida aquí por registros de museo.

evidence: GBIF: 28 records in the region (many are museum specimens)

sources.t: WoRMS: World Register of Marine Species, accepted name and range

recWhy: Recorded: GBIF: 28 records in the region (many are museum specimens).

marks.en: Small greenish-brown brittle star with a small disc and usually six slim arms that often split by fission.
marks.es: Ofiura pequeña pardo verdosa con disco chico y normalmente seis brazos delgados.
